title: A coord.py value put on a leased key is lost when the holder releases it or the lease expires
goal: (SP-rsmmwzr2 review G2) The end of a lease, a release or an expiry, clears holder, token and expiry and keeps the value and revision, as gate lifetime answers; a claim of a key that holds no live lease succeeds, a value left by a put on an absent key included (BG-v3fjhmro)

run:
import json,os,socket,subprocess as s,sys,tempfile,time
T='_tools/coord.py'
D=tempfile.mkdtemp()
E=dict(os.environ,KB_COORD_STORE=os.path.join(D,'c.db'))
def c(*a,t=30):
    p=s.run([sys.executable,T,*a],capture_output=True,text=True,env=E,timeout=t);return p.returncode,p.stdout,p.stderr
tok=json.loads(c('claim','K2','--ttl','60','--holder','a')[1])['token']
c('put','K2','--value','V','--revision','1');c('release','K2','--token',tok)
r1,o1,_=c('get','K2')
c('claim','K3','--ttl','1','--holder','a');c('put','K3','--value','W','--revision','1');time.sleep(1.6)
r2,o2,_=c('get','K3')
print(dict(after_release=r1,after_expiry=r2));sys.exit(0 if r1==0 and 'V' in o1 and r2==0 and 'W' in o2 else 1)

def c(*a,t=30):
    p=s.run([sys.executable,T,*a],capture_output=True,text=True,env=E,timeout=t);return p.returncode,p.stdout,p.stderr
c('put','K1','--value','x','--revision','0')
r=c('claim','K1','--ttl','5','--holder','a')[0]

gates.question: When a lease on a coord.py key ends (its holder lets it go or it runs out), what happens to a value put on that key? This changes the answer of ST-5iwikc3n gate g2, which let the value go with its lease.
options: keep: the end of a lease clears holder and expiry and keeps the value and revision; a key with no live lease can be claimed again (carries BG-v3fjhmro)
lease-bound: the value lives only as long as its lease (as etcd keys attached to a lease go with it), and the coord.py docstring and kb/_self/tools.md say so; the repro is rewritten
gates.recommendation: keep: the end of a lease clears holder and expiry and keeps the value and revision; a key with no live lease can be claimed again (carries BG-v3fjhmro)
gates.answer: keep: the end of a lease clears holder and expiry and keeps the value and revision; a key with no live lease can be claimed again (carries BG-v3fjhmro)

notes: Premise run 2026-10-16 on origin/main ed55f4d56: repro exits 1 ({'after_release': 1, 'after_expiry': 1}). Planned with BG-v3fjhmro's repro as a check: keeping a value past its lease leaves a row with no live lease, which claim must take again, the same code path BG-v3fjhmro asks for (a put on an absent key leaves such a row).
